checks: Valid colours and mute persist without a startup write; yesterday's daily minutes reset, and the next session saves today's minutes from zero while keeping lifetime totals
Damaged fields use defaults while valid theme, companion and progress survive; the original file is preserved on explicit repair
Colour, companion and mute changes save and survive a reload; playback increments numeric session/minute totals after recovery
Null and truncated settings show recovery instead of startup errors or silent data replacement
An unreadable settings file leaves a lasting warning; restore and reload resumes saved settings without relaunching
Delayed loading disables practice and preference edits until the saved state is ready, preventing overwritten early changes
